allocation_note: No new reservation or suballocation. This protocol uses the ordinary-feed-adapter-repair-v1 protocols category. Common adapter/tests and preserved old evidence use that repair allocation. This small wrapper uses the unused original study source/tests allowance. Corrected results/provenance/readouts use the original study outputs allowance; old v1 inventory evidence is retained under the repair category. The original protocol remains the authoritative method except for the explicit reader/output correction below.

method_reference.instruction: Inherit every definition, source-clock rule, calendar, parameter, matching rule, cost/latency/native-grid check, denominator, failure, research gate and limitation. The revision scope below is the complete set of changes.

revision_scope.change: Validate object/market/type envelope in live trades[]. Count and skip known nonordinary liquidation/deleverage/market-settlement types. Keep invalid ordinary, unknown/malformed subtype and wrong-market rejection, generation invalidation, dedup, history exclusion, archive/hash/clock checks. Exclusion counts can overlap liquidation_trades[] counts; never sum them as independent events. Frozen study implementation is imported unchanged.
revision_scope.previous_evidence: Old inventory batch1 is preserved but superseded as an intended-population test:7459 ordinary rows were omitted after mixed-type invalidations. Old flow batch1 was aborted before any result. Corrected runs remain exploratory because old outcomes were seen; no threshold was tuned.

input_contract: Require each named chunk to be sealed_complete, exploratory, and already pinned by flow_recovery_v1. Refuse unsealed, reserved, missing or unpinned input. Verify store identity, parent plan, index/seal SHA, exact seal inventory, capture manifest, raw and metadata hashes, and source pins. Hold the store lock for provenance snapshot and final recheck only; root-owned pins protect the intervening stream. No automatic input replacement. Each batch contains three independent 600-second captures with explicit gaps. Reset all features at capture boundaries and invalidations. Retain all ten assets and both venues.
stage: Corrected exploratory rerun on the identical named blocks. Flow remains feature-only; inventory remains conditional public-quote analysis. Neither establishes fills or realized profit. Reserved chunks remain excluded.

verification.ordinary_adapter: Root independently ran 4 synthetic tests successfully before correction execution, including mixed types, genuine malformed batches, history/dedup/generation behavior and preserved trade hook.

original_study.root_result: 6 tests passed; source reviewed before market execution. Tests include exact closed buckets, source anchors and stale advancing books, additive split fills, fixed price band, resets/missing anchors, episode spacing, role/pin rejection and immutable publication.

verification.launcher: Root checked new-adapter binding, bounded adapter configuration, absence of old-adapter mutation, normal restoration and restoration after synthetic failure using a mocked study.run; no captured-data access.
